Counsel for the petitioner after arguing the matter for some time submits that the petition may be dismissed as not pressed with liberty to the petitioner to renew his bail application after examination of the victim girl is completed before the Trial Court.
2. The submission is placed on record.
3. Accordingly, the petition is dismissed as not pressed with liberty as prayed for.
All contentions urged in this petition are kept open.

Sd/-
